name: fastfetch
summary: High-performance host system, hardware, and kernel diagnostic fetcher
description: fastfetch is a neofetch-like tool for fetching system information and displaying it prettily. It runs unconfined to query host DMI, Vulkan/GL hardware devices, kernel modules, and OS release telemetry.

curation.unconfined_reason: Requires access to host /sys, /proc, PCI/Vulkan devices, and display servers to accurately inspect host hardware
